modelspec.observatory.RunEventKind.title: RunEventKind
modelspec.observatory.RunEventKind.description: The SSE `event:` name of a StreamFrame, the `kind` tag of its RunEvent's body (RunEventBody).

modelspec.observatory.StreamFrame.title: StreamFrame
modelspec.observatory.StreamFrame.description: One Server-Sent Events frame of the live stream (epic:training-observatory, In scope, first bullet; story:observatory-live-event-stream, open question 1), the lines `event:`, `id:` and `data:` and a blank line. `GET /events` at the ServeAddress answers 200 with `Content-Type text/event-stream` and sends the run's events in sequence order from sequence 0, or from the one after a `Last-Event-ID` request header, then each new event as the run emits it, and closes the response after RunFinished or RunFailed; any other path answers 404. The process keeps serving after the run ends, so a client that connects late reads the whole stream, until the process is interrupted.

data.description: The JSON of one RunEvent on one line, valid against the JSON Schema `ess generate --kind schema` writes for it.
